description:
Trail-Ready Performance for Recreation and Everyday Adventure

Whether you're exploring local trails, riding gravel roads, or enjoying weekend adventures, the Sundance 510 27-Speed Mountain Bike is designed to provide confident handling and dependable performance across a wide range of riding conditions.
Its lightweight aluminum frame, front suspension fork, and Shimano 27-speed drivetrain work together to deliver efficient climbing, responsive handling, and smooth shifting for recreational mountain biking and everyday riding. Hydraulic disc brakes provide reliable stopping power in changing weather, while the 27.5-inch wheels offer an excellent balance of stability and maneuverability.
Designed for riders who want more capability than an entry-level mountain bike, the Sundance 510 is well suited for parks, gravel roads, forest trails, and everyday fitness rides.

Shimano 27-Speed Drivetrain
The Shimano 27-speed drivetrain provides a wide range of gears for climbing hills, riding flat roads, and adapting to changing trail conditions.
Shimano Rapidfire shifters deliver smooth, dependable gear changes, allowing riders to maintain an efficient cadence across a variety of terrain.

Lightweight Aluminum Frame
The lightweight aluminum frame offers an excellent balance of durability, efficiency, and responsive handling.
Its modern trail geometry provides a comfortable riding position while maintaining confident control on paved roads, gravel paths, and recreational trails.

Front Suspension for Trail Comfort
Uneven pavement, gravel roads, tree roots, and rocky paths are all part of everyday trail riding.
The suspension fork helps absorb these impacts, improving comfort and maintaining better front-wheel control across mixed terrain.

Hydraulic Disc Brakes for Confident Control
Front and rear Tektro hydraulic disc brakes provide powerful, consistent braking performance with less hand effort than traditional rim brakes.
Whether riding on dry dirt, wet pavement, or descending moderate hills, the braking system delivers dependable control and confidence.

27.5-Inch Wheels Built for Balanced Handling
The 27.5-inch wheels combine responsive handling with excellent rollover capability, making them well suited for recreational trail riding and everyday adventures.
The 27.5 × 1.95-inch tires provide dependable traction and stability across pavement, gravel roads, forest trails, and hard-packed dirt.

Ideal For
The Sundance 510 is an excellent choice for riders looking for one bike that can comfortably handle:

The Sundance 510 is designed for recreational mountain biking and light to moderate off-road riding. It is not intended for extreme downhill riding, technical mountain bike parks, large jumps, or competitive racing.
